BiblicalUsage: My mouth shall speak truth, says Wisdom, and wickedness is an abomination to my lips. The fast God chooses loosens the bands of wickedness, and the watchman who warns the wicked man has delivered his soul. Thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness, and even the place of judgment was found full of wickedness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe wickedness is not a mistake but a choice, and God hates it because it breaks what He loves. The fast He chooses is not a hungry day but a loosened chain, and the watchman who speaks is the mercy that stands between the wicked and their end. I hold that no one is beyond warning while the warning can still be heard.
RelatedPeople: King Solomon; Isaiah; Ezekiel; King David
